headline: Mobile navigation now meets its declared hard gates, startup and release evidence tell the truth, aggregate analytics are repeatably provable, and one exact compact-health artifact is live on stable staging and production.

items.title: Mobile navigation clears the rendered-pixel contract
items.evidence: The trigger is 44 by 44 pixels, the 100dvh drawer respects four-edge safe areas, global Escape leaves cold islands cold, and 255 responsive states passed with 96 retained dark/light desktop/tablet/mobile captures.

items.title: Startup and promotion evidence are actionable
items.evidence: Startup rejects corrupt dates and reads inline SIL v3 truth; artifact mismatches print both identities and first-file deltas from a deterministic 207-file ledger.

items.title: Analytics proof stays inside its evidence boundary
items.evidence: A secrets-gateway-backed verifier reproduces bounded aggregate Cloudflare RUM counts while explicitly withholding claims about users, sessions, engagement, retention, and cohorts; least-privilege follow-up shipped through Ark receipt 01K103S9CJB19ECBBDE12BC911.

items.title: The exact final artifact reached production
items.evidence: Source 590d145ef86b3520a6b7b24dbd159eb60788905a and artifact 5a92bea5d41678726fa7d7805a53443103a38fe7d58916ca39798ea99088a3d1 agree across visual, hosted-performance, staging 14/14, production 10/10, CI workflow 33026206650, and promotion workflow 33026545885.

followUps.title: Observe the first genuine opted-in cohort
followUps.evidence: Validate freshness, suppression, deletion, and abuse ceilings from real consented activity; do not manufacture a cohort.

followUps.title: Restore the stats surface only after its evidence threshold
followUps.evidence: Return /stats to the sitemap only when the community snapshot clears the declared suppression floor.

followUps.title: Reconcile public launch independently
followUps.evidence: Require Zoho receive/reply-as, explicit SHA-bound approval, authoritative lifecycle state, and applicable external Obelisk relying-party proof.

blockers.title: Public launch remains HOLD
blockers.evidence: Technical deployment is complete. Zoho delivery/reply-as, public-launch approval, lifecycle authority, and applicable external Obelisk proof remain independent; the authoritative registry also still says SPARKED while the local contract correctly says FORGE.

honestyLedger.title: Final doctor reconciliation found two real integration defects
honestyLedger.evidence: The first ledger representation made _health exceed a downstream read bound; the compact replacement initially disagreed with the verifier. Commits 8dd0743 and 590d145 fixed both and the final SHA was re-promoted.

honestyLedger.title: The full ledger is not exposed through public health
honestyLedger.evidence: _health is 846 bytes and carries compact identity; the complete deterministic 207-file ledger stays in the deploy manifest used for exact binding.

honestyLedger.title: Final test claims distinguish their boundaries
honestyLedger.evidence: The implementation-boundary canonical receipt is 1,293/1,293 across all six shards. Final-SHA push CI is 1,290/1,290 across its five configured shards, with focused final release/staging checks 26/26 and 19/19; no unrun six-shard total is invented.

honestyLedger.title: The closeout autopilot was stopped before it could commit misrouted Studio output
honestyLedger.evidence: Invoked with --project ., it rendered Studio Session 306 and ran Studio-root refresh tasks. The incorrect local output was removed, the repo-local renderer restored the truthful S97 brief, and the routing defect was returned through Ark receipt 01K10BKC0C4B276631DD0B1360 before a manual gated closeout.

diffStat.suite: Implementation-boundary canonical Node 1,293/1,293; final-SHA push CI 1,290/1,290 across five shards; Playwright 54/54; responsive 255 states and 96 reviewed captures; staging 14/14; production 10/10; doctor blockingFailing 0.
